Proposition
[maximum principle for the connection Laplacian]

Source: petersen:page-0357 1. ch9:9.3.1Suppose a section $T\in \Gamma (E)$ over a Riemannian manifold satisfies $g( abla ^* abla T,T)\le 0$ pointwise. If the function $|T|$ has a global maximum, then $ abla T=0$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch9-vanishing-connection-laplacian \sketch The tensor Bochner identity gives $\Delta frac 12|T|^2=| abla T|^2-g( abla ^* abla T,T)\ge 0$. At a maximum of $|T|$, the maximum principle forces this function to be constant and hence $ abla T=0$.

□
